BiblicalUsage: En-Mishpat is a place near Palestine. In Genesis 14:7, the text says "and came to En-mishpat." It is a place, not a person, so there is no People profile for it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe En-Mishpat matters because God's story happened in real places, and En-Mishpat is one of them.
